integrity.statement: All seven nonempty-state Markov reward equations and symbolic identities are specified; verify.py independently reproduces them using exact arithmetic. No external independent audit has occurred.

scientific_limitations: Three binary-occupancy habitats, exponential local extinction and additive edgewise recolonization, no immigration.
Exact mean absorption-time criterion, not time-horizon stochastic dominance or empirically estimated persistence.
One corridor may have zero weight. Strict positivity constraints remove the small-budget attained optimum.
Historical novelty remains provisional pending comparison with inaccessible earlier management papers.
title: A sharp colonization-budget switch between seed and community persistence on three habitats
